build_service_class_from_descriptor: build a protocol service class at runtime using GeneratedServiceType metaclass with a ServiceDescriptor
build_service_stub_from_descriptor: build a service stub class at runtime using GeneratedServiceStubType metaclass with a ServiceDescriptor
call_method_on_service: call a service method via CallMethod passing a method descriptor, rpc controller, request, and callback
get_request_class_for_method: get the request protocol message class for a given method descriptor using GetRequestClass
get_response_class_for_method: get the response protocol message class for a given method descriptor using GetResponseClass
